caption:
Claude Code just dropped Mods. Here are 3 ways to use them that no one is talking about:

1. Make your sessions talk to each other. One Claude Code session can send a message to another, so one plans while the other builds and they pass work between them.
2. Change the interface. Ask Claude to change any part of it, so you can have a dashboard right inside Claude Code, showing anything from what your agents are doing to a full overview of your second brain.
3. Send the easy stuff to a cheaper model. A mod can step in and route certain requests to a different model, so simple tasks stop eating into your limits.

The craziest part: just describe the mod you want to Claude and it builds it. You don't need to know anything technical.

Follow for more Claude tips like this.
